name: Littlestone Dimension
definition: The **Littlestone Dimension** of $\mathcal{H}$ is the largest depth of a complete binary tree whose internal nodes are labeled by domain points and for which every root-to-leaf sequence of edge labels is realized by a member of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Maximum depth of a complete binary tree shattered by the class.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strict_c_monotonic.proof: By definition, strictly monotonic means doubly monotonic and strictly c-monotonic.

strictly_monotonic.proof: By definition, a doubly monotonic strictly c-monotonic parameter is strictly monotonic.

monotonic.proof: Every shattered Littlestone tree for a subfamily is also shattered by the containing class.

p_monotonic.proof: Every shattered Littlestone tree for a projection is realized by the original class on the same queried coordinates.

tight_strict_c_monotonic.proof: The defining Littlestone recurrence takes the larger branch value when branches differ and one plus their common value when they agree.
